title: Q-RES-foerster-1974-O2: Instructions the observer can misread (measured 0.273, target >= 0.9)
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** research pass: foerster-1974 finding O2 is not-met (measured 0.273)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation research --probe foerster-1974:O2
**Prediction:** spec_quality >= 0.9 within 72 h
**Out of scope:** editing the study, its target or the paper to match the code; the measurement is changed only by changing the mechanism
**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation research --probe foerster-1974:O2`
**Status:** open

Concern: Instructions the observer can misread. The study: Work items are the system's descriptions of what to do. An item that passes intake has a machine-checkable done check, a prediction, an out-of-scope line and a live proof, so it cannot be read two ways by two agents.

Mechanisms that should answer it: SPEC-GATE-1 (foundation/specgate.py); SPEC-GATE-1 (seed/scripts/specgate.py).

Metric: share of open work items with a done check, a prediction, an out-of-scope line and a live proof (foundation/specgate.py), target >= 0.9. Improve the mechanism (or add one) until the probe passes; the white paper at /research updates itself from the same measurement.
